description: This script generates various distinguished name (DN) configurations for testing, including encoding, sorting, and normalization of RDNs and attributes, with functions to generate, manipulate, and output ASN.1 encoded names.

classes.name: RDN
classes.description: Represents a Relative Distinguished Name (RDN) with multiple attributes, capable of adding attributes and converting to ASN.1 string format.

classes.name: NameGenerator
classes.description: Builds a sequence of RDNs for generating distinguished names, supporting adding RDNs, converting to ASN.1 format, and token retrieval.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a PEM-encoded name file from ASN.1 configuration, invoking OpenSSL to parse ASN.1 and encode in base64.

methods.name: extra_whitespace
methods.description: Adds extra whitespace around the input string.

methods.name: case_swap
methods.description: Swaps the case of characters in the input string.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that runs multiple test cases to generate various name configurations.
